title: nephrolepis exaltata var. rivularis
intro: Nephrolepis exaltata var. rivularis, commonly known as Boston fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing stress, improving air quality, and acting as a natural humidifier. The therapeutic actions of Nephrolepis exaltata var. rivularis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
